minimalCalibrationRunRequired.purpose: Fill rate and same-load same-method noise evidence only; no L4/L5 correctness or fault requalification
minimalCalibrationRunRequired.candidateRule: Reuse current sampler bytes and accepted production/PG/Venue contracts. Any new calibration orchestration must have its own manifest/hash; do not label changed harness as exact-head 1208abd9.

duration.meaning: A proposed bounded first calibration attempt, not an already accepted duration or sufficiency guarantee. Exceeding any bound or lacking natural GC/comparable observations returns INCONCLUSIVE/BLOCKED, with no in-run extension.

arrivalPattern.dispatch: alternate two actors; at most one pending business command per actor; pause without catch-up burst when slots/backpressure block; exact unique identities; normal continuous fills and reconciliation; no deliberately persistent 60-order prefix
arrivalPattern.proposalRationale: 4/s is a proposed offered workload ceiling consistent with exact 25% and L6 <=1/s; it is NOT measured healthy rate or a frozen acceptance value. Keep real risk checks and accepted workload limits.
arrivalPattern.noiseControl: Use only r_L6 = r_H * 0.25 derived by the predeclared rule after the healthy phase and completed identity checks; no clipping/min(1,r_L6), no default 2/min; reject if r_L6 >1/s. Same timers/collector topology/load pattern as the future L6 run.

rateRuleProposal.windows: three fixed 100s windows within the 300s healthy interval, specified before T=0
rateRuleProposal.formula: r_i = N_i / actual monotonic seconds_i; r_H = min(r_1,r_2,r_3); r_L6 = r_H * 0.25
rateRuleProposal.numerator: Unique identities admitted and fully completed inside each declared window; completion requires read-only durable evidence through TradeExecuted/Ledger/Position/Snapshot and matching Venue fill. Record boundary carry separately, never count it twice.
rateRuleProposal.eligibility: No fault/restart, no unexplained rejection or stalled consumer, no unclassified backpressure, all intervals present. Keep offered/admitted/completed/rejected rates distinct. This new prospective rule requires explicit freezing before a future run; it is not a reconstruction of an old accepted definition.

resources: heap used/committed/max and natural GC count/time/observed low-water by actor PID generation
Windows handles or Linux FD by owned generation

minimalCalibrationRunRequired.noiseDerivation: Use matched L6-noise-control and quiet-drain separately, per resource owner/generation. Emit min/max/max-min/count/method and exact sample indices. Associate heap lows with repeated natural GC observations; never System.gc. Normalize legitimate log/temp/audit growth by time/business work and retain raw cumulative values; do not compare inevitable evidence-file growth to a zero-growth recovery threshold.

safetyBudgetProposal.memory: reuse accepted process heaps/PG limits; total budget <=60% entry available memory
safetyBudgetProposal.termination: Stop producer, bounded drain, preserve evidence, cleanup owned only; no budget relaxation
